top_choice_rationale: P001 most precisely recognizes a mature, foundational discovery that established distinct B- and T-lymphocyte lineages as the organizing architecture of adaptive immunity. Its exceptional explanatory and medical reach is matched by a comparatively compact, complementary attribution to Miller and Cooper, provided the citation remains confined to the defined lineage discoveries.
recusal_note: No connection to the proposed laureates or achievement is apparent from the supplied profile. The documented co-authorship with committee member Thomas Perlmann does not concern this proposal.
